# Pause, sleep, wake (spec 02 §7.4, §9, D16).
config guest=1 first_ball=home pause=5m sleep=3m on_wake=smart
next official

# Manual pause: the clock stops; the next goal resumes the game and counts.
coin home 04000007 player=7
coin away 04000003 player=3
wait 5s
expect phase playing                                  # game 1
wait 10s
pause
expect last paused
expect playtime 10s
wait 1m
expect playtime 10s
sensor home_goal
expect written resumed,goal
expect score 0:1
expect playtime 10s
pause
minus away                                            # corrections while paused don't resume
expect score 0:0
expect last goal_voided
plus away                                             # but a goal does
expect written resumed,goal
pause
resume
expect last resumed
resume
expect error                                          # not paused any more

# Inactivity: 5 minutes without anything → paused (backdated), coins out, asleep.
wait 4m
expect phase playing
wait 1m
expect phase sleeping
expect power sleep
expect eject home,away
expect status 1 paused
expect reason 1 timeout
expect recent 1
expect regs home=_,_ away=_,_
expect playtime 10s                                   # the idle minutes don't count
ejected home
ejected away
expect phase sleeping                                 # the eject reports don't wake the table
sensor home_goal
expect phase sleeping                                 # nor do the goal sensors (off while asleep)

# smart: the paused game continues once at least one of its players is back on each side.
coin away 04000003 player=3
expect power wake
expect phase idle                                     # waiting for a home player of game 1
expect recent 1
coin home 04000009 player=9                           # not a player of game 1: no resume yet,
expect phase pregame                                  # the normal kickoff countdown runs
coin home 04000007 player=7                           # 7 is back: game 1 continues
expect phase playing
expect status 1 active
expect recent none
expect regs home=9,7 away=3,_                         # registered for the game after it
expect roster home=7,_ away=3,_                       # the game keeps its own players
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
sensor home_goal
expect winner away
expect eject none                                     # the registrations wait for the next game
wait 10s
expect phase pregame                                  # 9 and 7 against 3
start official                                        # "Start now": game 2
expect roster home=9,7 away=3,_
sensor away_goal

# Once a new game was started, smart wake leaves the paused game alone: by hand only.
pause
wait 4m
expect phase sleeping                                 # paused by hand, then 3 minutes of nothing
expect recent 2
expect status 2 paused
ejected home
ejected away
coin home 04000001 player=1                           # the guest: not a participant → no resume
expect phase idle
expect recent 2
restart
expect recent 2                                       # still smart-resumable after a restart
start official                                        # game 3: a new game was started …
expect recent none                                    # … so game 2 is only resumed by hand now
restart
expect recent none                                    # also after a restart
sensor away_goal

# Resuming from the paused list: the running game with goals goes to the paused list too.
# Nothing continues by itself afterwards (D16 as changed on 2026-11-23).
resume_game 2
expect status 3 paused
expect reason 3 switched
expect status 2 active
sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
sensor away_goal
expect winner home                                    # game 2 is over
wait 10s
expect phase idle                                     # only the guest is registered
expect status 3 paused                                # game 3 waits in the paused list

# Resuming while the running game has no goals: it is discarded.
resume_game 3
expect status 3 active
start official                                        # "Start new game": game 3 → paused list
expect status 3 paused
expect reason 3 new_game
expect phase idle
start official                                        # game 4
resume_game 3
expect deleted 4
expect status 3 active

# on_wake: resume always continues, new_game never; the Wake button.
config on_wake=resume
pause
wait 3m
expect phase sleeping
wake
expect power wake
expect status 3 active
config on_wake=new_game
pause
wait 3m
coin home 04000009 player=9
expect phase idle
expect recent 3

# Abandoned after hours (the table's job), reinstated by a member.
abandon 3
expect status 3 abandoned
expect recent none
resume_game 3
expect error
reinstate 3
expect status 3 paused
reinstate 3
expect error

# Without a game, the table sleeps after sleep_after.
wait 3m
expect phase sleeping
wait 1h
expect phase sleeping
